About Saints Capital 

 Saints Capital is a venture capital firm focused on building
long-term partnerships with leading venture capital general partners and
institutional investors by providing liquidity through secondaries. We work
closely with our network to identify compelling opportunities, support general
partners at venture capital funds by providing differentiated solutionswhile, at the same time, delivering
outstanding returns to our limited partner investors.

 We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and
self-starter Chief of Staff – Investor Communications & Marketing to
support the Managing Partner and partners across firm activities, with
particular emphasis on investor communications, marketing, and relationship
management as well as some administrative support functions.

 Role Overview 

 The Chief of Staff will serve in a support role to the Managing
Partner and investment team, helping ensure seamless execution across investor
outreach, marketing, and firm operations. This role is ideal for someone who is
detail-oriented, relationship-driven, and excited to operate at the center of a
growing venture capital platform.

 While the role supports the team broadly, its primary focus
is investor communications, marketing, and external engagement ,
including roadshows, meetings, events, and ongoing relationship management as
well as executive operations management.
